description: Zoom provides video meetings, chat, phone, rooms, whiteboard, developer platform, and related workplace and customer-experience services. Its developer platform includes APIs, AI services, SDK-related APIs, and AI-agent connectivity via MCP.
summary: Zoom exposes a REST API at `api.zoom.us/v2`, a beta GraphQL API at `api.zoom.us/v3/graphql`, an OAuth-protected MCP server at `mcp.zoom.us/mcp/zoom/streamable`, and the Zoom Rooms Control System SSH CLI surface.
